description_en: Updates the log collection configuration of an edge container application
description_zh: 更新边缘容器应用日志采集配置
kebab_example: aliyun esa update-edge-container-app-log-river --app-id app-880688675783790000 --stdout true --path /root/hello.log --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateEdgeContainerAppLogRiver

parameters.help_en:
The application ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2852396.html operation to obtain the application ID.
<notice>The AppId is in the format of the app- prefix followed by a numeric suffix, with a total length of 20 to 64 characters (example: app-8806886*83794688). Call ListEdgeContainerApps to obtain an existing AppId, or call CreateEdgeContainerApp to create an application first.</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
应用ID，可使用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2852396.html接口获取应用ID。
<notice>AppId 格式为 app- 前缀后接纯数字后缀，总长度 20 至 64 字符（示例：app-8806886*83794688）。可调用 ListEdgeContainerApps 获取已有 AppId，或先调用 CreateEdgeContainerApp 创建应用。</notice>
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_zh: 开启容器的标准输出采集
